summary: Dedicated: request timeouts after autoscaler scale-up (us-east)
description:
Issue summary:
- Northstar dedicated cluster: timeouts increase immediately after scaling from 8 -> 12 GPUs.

Impact:
- ~10% requests failing with 504s at customer ingress.
- Customers see spike during business hours; off-peak is normal.

Primary symptom: Request timeouts
Deployment offering: Dedicated

Environment:
- Dedicated pool: northstar-prod-us-east

Notes:
- Customer uses their own NLB with 60s timeout.
- We suspect new pods are marked Ready before the runtime is actually warm (model load / KV cache init).

Related:
- Fireflies call notes referenced: fireflies/customer-success/2026-03-12-northstar-weekly-sync
comments: Laura Bennett (2026-03-12): Escalating; customer is on weekly sync now and asking for immediate mitigation.
Hiro Tanaka (2026-03-12): Confirmed readiness probe only checks HTTP health, not model-loaded state.
Hiro Tanaka (2026-03-13): Added warmup gate: keep pods out of service until model load completes; deploying to northstar cluster.
Laura Bennett (2026-03-14): Customer reports timeouts resolved after last night’s scale event.
